RACE GUIDE
6th race of JANEV CUP 2026
GRAND PRIX PRACHATICE
National race for categories Men and Women Beginner, Men and
Women Cadet, Men Junior
Prachatice – 17/11/2026
Organiser: LYKO KLUB Prachatice z.s.
Date: Tuesday 17 November 2026
Venue: Prachatice (48.9982300N, 14.0173400E; https://cxprachatice.cz/)
Race Director: Václav Dostál
Mobile: +420 737 291 159
Email: lykoklub@seznam.cz
Race secretary Lenka Dostálová
Mobile: +420 602 660 263
Email: lenka.dostalova1@seznam.cz
Course Director Václav Dostál
Mobile: +420 737 291 159
Email: lykoklub@seznam.cz
President of
Commissaires‘ panel: MACHÁČEK Tomáš, CZE
Commissaires‘ panel: FOUS Zdeněk, KULHÁNEK Tomáš, MACEK Ondřej, ROTHBAUER Stanislav, SKÁLA
Robert, (all CZE)
Registrations: Registration instructions can be found at https://cycling.sportsoft.cz/. Registrations shall
be submitted to each race separately in electronic form on the website
https://cycling.sportsoft.cz/cyklokros. Please follow the competition guide, race guides,
follow the news at www.cyklokros.cz.
The deadline for registrations and payments is 12 November 2026 at 9:00 am.
Unpaid registrations are invalid. On-site registration at the race office is possible subject
to the conditions set out in the JANEV CUP 2026 Competition Guide.
Conditions: All riders must hold a valid licence issued by their national cycling federation for the year
2026.
Racing fee: According to the JANEV CUP 2026 Competition Guide
Race office: Prachatice - Recycling Centre (Sběrný dvůr)
Start numbers: At the race office on Monday 16 November 2026 from 16:00 to 17:30 and on Tuesday
17 November 2026 from 8:00 as follows:
- for WOMEN BEGINNER OLDER and YOUNGER no later than 09:00
- for MEN BEGINNER YOUNGER no later than 09:15
- for MEN BEGINNER OLDER no later than 10:00
- for WOMEN CADET no later than 11:30
- for MEN CADET no later than 12:00
- for MEN JUNIOR no later than 13:00

Schedule: Monday 16 November 2026:
14:30–16:00 Official training
Tuesday 17 November 2026:
08:45–9:25 Official training
09:40 WOMEN BEGINNER OLDER and WOMEN BEGINNER YOUNGER (joint
start after one minute for 20 min., a separate evaluation of each category)
10:20 MEN BEGINNER YOUNGER (a separate start, 20 min.)
11:00 MEN BEGINNER OLDER (a separate start, 20 min.)
11:30–12:00 Awards ceremony for categories WOMEN BEGINNER YOUNGER and
OLDER, MEN BEGINNER YOUNGER and OLDER
11:30–12:10 Official training
12:20 WOMEN CADET (a separate start, 30 min.)
13:10 MEN CADET (a separate start, 30 min.)
14:00 MEN JUNIOR (a separate start, 40 min.)
14:50–15:10 Awards ceremony for categories WOMEN CADET, MEN CADET, MEN
JUNIOR
Regulations: Competition runs according to the valid Czech Cycling Federation regulations, JANEV
CUP 2026 Competition Guide and according to this guide. In case of violation of the rules,
sanctions will be applied according to the Czech Cycling Federation rules. Each
competitor starts at his/her own risk, the organizer is not liable for damages incurred or
caused by competitors. The organizer reserves the right to make any necessary technical
changes compared the race guide due to unforeseen circumstances.
Race course: 2500 m, double pit
Awards ceremony: According to the schedule above
Prizes: According to the JANEV CUP 2026 Competition Guide
Doping control: Prachatice - Recycling Centre (Sběrný dvůr)
Changing rooms, Prachatice - Recycling Centre (Sběrný dvůr)
showers:
Medical service: Prachatice Hospital, Nebahovská 1015, 383 01 Prachatice
Tel.: +420 388 600 111
Parking: At the race venue
If you are interested in team parking and caravans, please contact the race director.
Accommodation: The organiser doesn´t organise the accommodation.
Approved by: Jiří Šťastný on behalf of the Czech Cycling Federation Cyclo-cross Committee on
August 3, 2026
